title: Bug classification, deduplication and report mappings, and their recovery branches (153)
description: Bug classification, deduplication and report mappings, and their recovery branches (153)
acceptance_criteria: REQ-cli-054 (new) states the bug value, deduplication and report mappings and their recovery branches; six tests in tests/bugs.rs assert its six criteria. Two fail first on defects found at 64aa77e0: a mistaken duplicate cannot be reopened, and a bug can relate to itself, with refusals naming no recovery. A small src/bugs.rs change fixes them: reopening clears duplicate_of, self-related links are refused, and refusals name chough bug list --all or chough bug update <id> --observation <id>. The four mapping tests each fail under a targeted mutation that the existing tests let pass. Every refusal's recovery command is run by a test. fledge lanes run verify passes on Linux.

answers.constraints: Issue #153 (audit REPORT.md Bugs row and the Chough: bugs 90% rating); the orc's overnight assignment for Leif (2026-11-06): own issue, a worktree from origin/main, failing tests first, a mutation check, approval queued for Leif; REQ-cli-054 from the Chough ID registry. Rule: a refusal names a command that recovers and a test runs it. Lesson 2026-11-05: merge main before review and rebuild the vault.
